title: Mag-Bind Blood & Tissue DNA HDQ 96 Kit Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Mag-Bind Blood & Tissue DNA HDQ 96 Kit

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set number of samples (1‑96, multiple of 8), initial sample volume (µL), elution volume (µL), flash‑on‑pause option, and P300 multi‑channel mount (left or right) in the OT‑2 script.

steps.title: Mix binding buffer/bead mixture
steps.instruction: Vigorously mix the binding buffer/bead mixture to disperse beads; repeat mixing each time a well is first accessed (every 4th column).

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the binding buffer into each well of the deep‑well plate positioned on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Remove first supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant from each well and dispense into the waste container in slot 4; reuse tips from the first tip rack (slot 1) for subsequent supernatant removals.

steps.title: Second VHB wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the VHB wash: add 600 µL VHB buffer, mix, engage magnet for 5 min, then remove supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to final plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the specified elution volume of DNA eluate to the destination plate located in slot 3.
